crossRefs.note: He does great things past finding out; yes, marvelous things without number.
“Can you fathom the mystery of God? Or can you probe the limits of the Almighty?
God thunders marvelously with his voice. He does great things, which we can’t comprehend.
Many, Yahweh, my God, are the wonderful works which you have done, and your thoughts which are toward us. They can’t be…
Praise be to Yahweh God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds.
For you are great, and do wondrous things. You are God alone.
Oh the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and the knowledge of God! How unsearchable are his judgments, and his…
Haven’t you known? Haven’t you heard? The everlasting God, Yahweh, the Creator of the ends of the earth, doesn’t faint.…
crossRefs.keyword: unsearchable. Heb. there is no search

crossRefs.note: “The departed spirits tremble, those beneath the waters and all that live in them.

crossRefs.note: If I would count them, they are more in number than the sand. When I wake up, I am still with you.
